dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Primary 'O' shaped structure located mid-dorsal shows a 360-degree dark perimeter with high edge sharpness. Two adjacent 'C' shaped structures are visible immediately posterior, with the openings oriented towards the ventral-posterior. A fourth prominent 'O' structure is positioned lower on the mid-flank, exhibiting a slightly more diffused gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Densely packed clusters of low-intensity pixel groups are visible in the axillary region behind the flipper and extending along the ventral midline. These blobs are characterized by uniform interior intensity without the lighter centers observed in the annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent 'O' structures form a non-equilateral quadrilateral. Connecting the centroids of the five dark blobs along the posterior-lateral line defines a shallow arc.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral flipper features five distinct, high-contrast dark terminal structures (claws) arranged in a fan-like geometry against the lighter fur of the limb.
